trial_court: Additional Civil Judge and Judicial Magistrate No.15, Jaipur Metropolitan in Session Case No.6/2019
case_name: Himanshu Bhardwaj S/O Shri Mohan Lal vs State Of Rajasthan

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Himanshu Bhardwaj S/o Shri Mohan Lal Sharma, R/o Plot No. 8, Chomu Haveli, Gangapole, Jaipur — husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Khushbu Sharma W/o Shri Himanshu Bhardwaj, D/o Late Shri Mahendra Kumar Sharma, Aged About 26 Years, R/o C-13, Ojhaji Ka Bagh, Gandhi Nagar, Jaipur — wife

facts_of_case: Parties entered into a compromise; petitioner has deposited demand draft before the Family Court; application moved for attesting the compromise; parties filed an application under Section 32-B of Hindu Marriage Act before the Family Court.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise between parties can be attested by the court.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that an application was moved before the Court below for attesting the compromise.

legal_principles.principle: Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code is non-compoundable.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that Section 498-A is non-compoundable, the same was not compounded.

outcome.final_order: Offence under Section 498-A is compounded. Stay application stands disposed.
